task_text: Clear all main tables and counters

central_instructions.R1: Clear all light objects from the main table in the kitchen and pass them to R2 for further processing.
central_instructions.R2: Receive light objects from R1 and ensure the kitchen counters are cleared of any remaining light objects.
central_instructions.R3: Clear all light objects from the main table in the living room and pass them to R4 for further processing.
central_instructions.R4: Receive light objects from R3 and ensure the living room counters are cleared of any remaining light objects.
